scripts.runtime:dev: uv run --project apps/runtime uvicorn voice_agent_runtime.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --reload --reload-dir apps/runtime/src --reload-dir ../src
scripts.runtime:test: uv run --project apps/runtime python -m unittest discover -s apps/runtime/tests -v
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/runtime alembic -c alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:status: uv run --project apps/runtime alembic -c alembic.ini current
scripts.lint: npm run lint:studio && npm run lint:python
scripts.lint:python: uv run --project apps/runtime ruff check apps/runtime/src apps/runtime/tests packages/persistence/src migrations scripts
scripts.format: npm run format:studio && npm run format:python
scripts.format:check: npm run format:studio:check && npm run format:python:check
scripts.format:python: uv run --project apps/runtime ruff format apps/runtime/src apps/runtime/tests packages/persistence/src migrations scripts
scripts.format:python:check: uv run --project apps/runtime ruff format --check apps/runtime/src apps/runtime/tests packages/persistence/src migrations scripts
